notes.title: Patch 1.0.10 - Performance, Bugs, Upcoming Content
notes.notes:
Good day! Today is a patch that will hopefully increase performance across the board for all players and fix some of the black wall decals on lower quality settings. 

Performance

 Adjusted all lighting resolutions and the frequency at which they render. 
 Adjusted shadow culling.
 Removed volumetric fog on Medium quality settings.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a soft lock that would occur if you dug up and buried too many graves without looting them.
 Fixed an issue where your Continue button would appear even if your game data had been erased because you were meant to be killed.
 Fixed decals in Medium and Low quality settings that were appearing black.


This should be the last update for the game until I release the Joseph Story patch, which should be coming in just a couple weeks. Here are some of the features that will be coming with the new patch:

Joseph's Story Upcoming Content Patch Features

 A new puzzle and mystery to solve which will lead to a 3rd ending.
 A new item and new boosts will be available.
 Much more story and lore elements will be added.
 New body and casket types.
 Many new horror events.
 Changes made to the digging process that should fix issues with those playing the game on older hardware. 


After the release of this patch I will start working on the Halloween event and will start adding in additional language options. More info on that later!

Thank you all for the continued support! Happy digging!
-Austin

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8 - Saving, Bad Luck Protection, Balance, & More!
notes.notes:
Happy Monday, Gravediggers!

You will now save your data on Standard Difficulty every time you sleep and survive the night. After sleeping, you may exit the game and continue from where you last left off. If you flagged to lose the game on your next sleep, your save data will be deleted immediately. I have more detail information on how the saving works below the patch changes.

New

 You will now save the game when you sleep (Standard Difficulty only).
 There is now a continue option to load your saved game (Standard Difficulty only).
 There is now bad luck protection on loot (All difficulties)
 The value of the items you loot and the total value of loot for the body is now displayed while looting the casket.
 Display text will now always update to new text when prompted.
 Added new horror events.
 Added a sound effect to the alms box when depositing items.

Standard Difficulty Changes

 You will now start with 3 Crucifix, up from 2.
 You will now start with 2 Lockpicks, up from 1.

Hard Difficulty Changes

 You will now start with 2 Crucifix, up from 1.
 You will now start with 1 Lockpicks, up from 0.
 You will now start with $75, up from $50.
 Cleansing corruption will now restore 24 sanity seconds, up from 20 (this also includes prevented corruption from a crucifix).

Nightmare Difficulty Changes

 You will now start with 1 Crucifix, up from 0.
 You will now start with $50, up from $0.
 Cleansing corruption will now restore 18 sanity seconds, up from 10 (this also includes prevented corruption from a crucifix).


More Information on Saving
When you save and load the game, it will save all of your essential data and regenerate the rest. The game will save data such as your money, sanity, items, items-to-be-delivered, boosts, burnt bone progress, which value of caskets you've looted, the demons power, etc. The game will not save which graves have and have not been looted, tombstone names or un-looted compartment boxes. 

The data that is not saved will be regenerated when you load your game. It will look at how many graves you dug, how many valuable graves you dug, and repopulate the graveyard with an appropriate amount of graves based on where you saved. 

Please let me know if you run into any issues! Thank you so much for the continued support!
-Austin

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7 - New settings, more death info, improved Ankh
notes.notes:
Happy Friday all!

I wanted to get this patch out before the weekend as I will not be available! There are some events that I wanted finished but still need some work and will have to come with the next patch.

The next patch will also have balancing changes for Hard and Nightmare mode as well as a reduction in randomness for those modes specifically. 

Have a great weekend, thank you all for the continued support and happy digging!

New:

 There is now a wall counter displaying your current digs for the night.
 Volumetric Fog toggle has been added to the Display Settings.
 Item Glow Effect has been added to the Accessibility Settings.
 Added some new horror events, there will be more coming with the next patch.
 Added a new death screen that gives some information about the main cause of your death.


Changes:

 Ankh now guarantees you survive the night.
 Additional message prompts can display when surviving the night.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed a small bug that was causing Corruption to speed up a little too fast.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6 - Corruption balance, death balance, bug fixes!
notes.notes:
Happy weekend all! Sending a quick patch of some needed adjustments that hopefully will help alleviate some of the more punishing aspects of the game. These changes should allow you to spend much more time working in the graveyard instead of having to rush and quickly get the body quota complete.

Just keep in mind of your remaining sanity, which can be represented by [spoiler]the painting in the hallway[/spoiler]. If it has reached the final stage, you will then risk the chance of being killed.

In an upcoming update this next week, I will be adding and fixing some of the horror events. There are a handful of events that are currently disabled that need to be fixed, and I will be adding many more as well as some new body types and casket variants. 

Changes

 You can no longer die until you are on the final stage of sanity remaining.
 Corruption will happen less frequently.
 Corruption can not happen back-to-back after looting a burnt bone piece.
 Corruption that is not cleansed and blackens will be less punishing.
 The Ankh will no longer trigger until you are on the final stage of sanity remaining.
 The Ankh will provide more time when triggered.
 Moved the hallway painting to the other side of the wall and added an additional spotlight.
 Added a toilet interaction sound effect.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed bug with the casket getting stuck when standing too close to it and pushing it.
 Fixed Low Quality settings and reverted them back to their original amounts.
 Fixed Ultra Quality lighting using an 8192 resolution instead of 4096 for all point lights.
 Fixed the skull and pelvis burnt bone being swapped while placing them on the altar or in the mausoleum.
 Fixed the battery description not being aligned properly.


Thank you everyone for the continued support. Enjoy the weekend and happy digging!
-Austin

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 - Bug Fixes, New Bodies, New Casket Variants and more!
notes.notes:
Good day everyone! Here is the patch for the day with some new content, many balance changes and some bug fixes. I am continuing to work on more fixes and content additions and will try to get the next patch out in the next day or two!

Thank you everyone for playing my game and thank you for the positive words, feedback and support! I hope you enjoy!

New:

 2 new bodies added
 7 new casket variants added
 Additional information on casket value
 Tutorial popup added when collecting an interesting item (this was in the previous patch but I forgot to list it)

Changes:

 You will now always find an interesting item on the first night.
 Increased the chance for loot to spawn on bodies.
 Increased the chance for a casket to have a compartment.
 Increased the time between corruption spawning.
 Reduced how fast the corruption spawning speeds up.
 Corruption spawning now has a cap for how often it can occur.
 Increased the volume levels of most things.
 Crucifix animation now happens faster.

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed flashlight not working on Medium or Low settings.
 Fixed body and loot spawning before the casket arrives on the table by pausing the game.
 Fixed soft lock that occurred when a tutorial popup happened during an animation.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - Bug Fixes and Balance Adjustments
notes.notes:
Good day all! Here are some bug fixes to address big issues. Please let me know if there are still problems with freezing/blackscreens after this change!

Changes

 Price reduced for the crucifix from $35 to $30.
 Dowsing Rods and Blacklight last twice as long.
 Intro text and fade screen now last half as long.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed issue after losing that your mouse is locked and unusable at the title screen.
 Fixed issue where the screen permanently goes black after digging/burying a grave.
 Fixed issue where the screen would become frozen after interacting with a grave or casket immediately after digging up a grave.
 Fixed issue where the blacklight and dowsing rods were degrading during animations.
 Fixed chalkboard description on the computer.


Thank you everyone, more updates to come!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
This patch is just a quick balancing adjustment as the game was a bit more difficult than intended for Standard difficulty and a couple small bug fixes.

Will be doing regular patches to iron out all of the bugs and continue adding new things such as more body types, more casket types and more horror events.

Thank you!
